findings.suggested_fix: Evaluate bitbucketAPITokenDefined and bitbucketOAuthDefined into separate variables before combining them, and cover a complete API configuration with an unreadable OAuth credential file.
findings.title: Preserve OAuth file diagnostics during Bitbucket collection
findings.why_it_matters: When API credentials are complete and an OAuth credential file is missing or unreadable, each backup run emits fewer file diagnostics than before. The earlier code evaluated both credential sets before selecting Bitbucket, whereas the new short-circuit skips the OAuth file reads; this changes the explicitly preserved log output. Evaluating both checks before the OR restores those diagnostics.
